name: Beatrice LeBlanc
source: [spoiler]A sinister witch who serves the Overlord. She hunts the Seals of the founders to bend their will and unleash the Overlord into our world. She attacked me when I found Jaina's Seal and Jacob had to sacrifice himself to protect me. Thanks to Jacob's curse, she is banished from the Academy grounds.[/spoiler]
